name: Content - Live Preview
description: Grants read access to pages and posts for live preview. Assigned to the Administrator role (your onboarding admin). Apply template-licensed for enforceable rules.

name: Team - App Access
description: Grants Directus Studio access to team members

name: Content - Manage
description: Grants ability to read and edit ALL content. Used by Editor and Content Admin roles.

name: Content - Self
description: Grants ability to edit own content only. Used by the Writer role. Apply template-licensed for author-scoped enforcement.

name: Content - Public
description: Grants read access to website content collections. Frontends filter to published content in queries. Apply template-licensed for API-level published filters.

name: Forms - Submission
description: Grants ability to create form submissions. Used by the Frontend Bot machine user.
